AboutPage.title: About Us
AboutPage.content01: As Alfa Emlak, we aim to add value for our clients with a service culture built on trust, transparency, and professionalism in real estate.
AboutPage.content02: We believe property is not only an asset but also a life plan, an investment, and a vision for the future. That is why we analyse each client's needs carefully and work to deliver the right solutions.
AboutPage.content03:
With our experienced team and experts who know the region:
• Residential
• Land
• Commercial property
• Investment projects
we provide professional consultancy.
AboutPage.content04: We follow sector trends closely and use modern marketing, digital tools, and a strong communication network effectively—matching our portfolios with the right investors.
AboutPage.content05: For us, success is not only completing a sale. We believe real success means earning our clients' trust, guiding them well, and achieving lasting satisfaction.
AboutPage.content06: Thanks to our professional approach for local and international investors, transparent processes, and solution-oriented service, we continue to grow as a strong, reliable brand in real estate.
AboutPage.content07: Our goal as Alfa Emlak is to offer our clients not only a property but the right investment and a secure future.
AboutPage.faqTitle: Frequently asked questions when buying property in Northern Cyprus
AboutPage.faqQ01: Can foreigners buy property in Northern Cyprus?
AboutPage.faqA01: Yes. Citizens of Turkey and other countries can buy property in Northern Cyprus within specific legal procedures. The purchase process progresses subject to government approval.
AboutPage.faqQ02: What types of title deeds exist?
AboutPage.faqA02:
Common title types in Northern Cyprus include:
• Turkish title (Koçan)
• Equivalent title (eşdeğer)
• Allocation title (tahsis)
Before investing, the title type should be reviewed in detail by specialists.
AboutPage.faqA03: Title transfer takes place after required permits and formalities are completed. Some projects may proceed with a pre-completion sale agreement. Professional guidance helps the process stay safe.
AboutPage.faqQ04: Is it safe to buy property in Northern Cyprus?
AboutPage.faqA04:
With the right project, thorough title checks, and professional advice, the process can proceed safely. Always verify:
• Title research
• Developer track record
• Project permits
• Contract terms
AboutPage.faqQ05: Which areas are most popular for investment?
AboutPage.faqA05:
Areas that have attracted strong investor interest include:
• İskele
• Girne (Kyrenia)
• Gazimağusa (Famagusta)
• Lefkoşa (Nicosia)
• Esentepe
Choice of area depends on your investment goals.
AboutPage.faqA06:
Many projects offer:
• Cash payment
• In-house instalments
• Bank finance
• Construction-linked payment plans
Longer plans on new builds can be advantageous for investors.
AboutPage.faqQ07: Is rental yield high in Northern Cyprus?
AboutPage.faqA07: Yields vary by area and project. Locations such as university zones, coastal projects, and tourist areas can offer strong rental potential.
AboutPage.faqQ08: Can I rent out a property after purchase?
AboutPage.faqA08: Yes. Investment properties can be let short- or long-term. Some developments offer professional lettings and management services.
AboutPage.faqQ09: What taxes and costs should I expect?
AboutPage.faqA09:
Typical costs may include:
• Stamp duty
• VAT
• Title transfer fees
• Legal fees
• Infrastructure / transformer contributions
Calculate total cost before you commit.
AboutPage.faqA10:
It is strongly recommended. A qualified lawyer can:
• Check title
• Review contracts
• Reduce legal risk
• Keep the process secure
This is especially important for foreign buyers.
AboutPage.faqA11:
They can offer strong opportunities when the developer and project are well vetted. Research:
• Past projects
• Delivery record
• Permits
• Build quality
AboutPage.faqA12: Property owners who meet certain conditions may apply for residency. Rules change over time, so official procedures should be followed with expert support.
AboutPage.faqQ13: Does investing in Northern Cyprus make sense?
AboutPage.faqA13:
Northern Cyprus attracts investors for reasons such as:
• FX-based investment appeal
• Growing construction sector
• University and tourism potential
• Foreign buyer interest
• Lifestyle and coastline
As with any investment, thorough analysis is essential.
AboutPage.faqA14: Correct title, the right project, and reliable consultancy. Professional support significantly reduces risk.
AboutPage.faqQ15: Why work with a professional estate agent?
AboutPage.faqA15:
A professional consultant:
• Analyses locations
• Presents suitable opportunities
• Manages negotiation
• Guides legal steps
• Saves time and cost
Your transaction stays safer and more controlled.
